mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over three months signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% MoM, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO declines > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
